items.summary: Seven vulnerabilities have been discovered in Ruby’s regular expression engine and in the case conversion of strings. We are aware of PoCs that prove some of them can be used to trigger remote code execution.
items.title: Security advisories: multiple vulnerabilities in Regexp and String case conversion

items.summary: We have released Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13. They fix several bugs in Ruby’s regular expression engine (Onigmo) that GitLab found could be used for remote code execution on GitLab servers.
items.title: Regexp compilation fixes related to GitLab's CVE-2026-89078, CVE-2026-93577, CVE-2026-97229 and CVE-2026-110264
